blocks.title: Welcome to Statistics
blocks.body: Before we dive in, let's look at a real-life example of this concept.
blocks.body_hi: इससे पहले कि हम शुरू करें, आइए इस अवधारणा का एक वास्तविक जीवन उदाहरण देखें।

blocks.title: Example 1
blocks.body: Using the empirical relationship, find the mode if mean = 30 and median = 28 (Mode = 3×Median − 2×Mean).
blocks.body_hi: Using the empirical relationship, find the mode if mean = 30 and median = 28 (Mode = 3×Median − 2×Mean).

blocks.title: Example 2
blocks.body: Find the mean of the data using direct method: values 10,20,30 with frequencies 2,3,5.
blocks.body_hi: Find the mean of the data using direct method: values 10,20,30 with frequencies 2,3,5.

blocks.title: Example 3
blocks.body: The cumulative frequency up to class 0-20 is 12, and the class 20-40 has frequency 8. Find the cumulative frequency up to 20-40.
blocks.body_hi: The cumulative frequency up to class 0-20 is 12, and the class 20-40 has frequency 8. Find the cumulative frequency up to 20-40.
